verdicts.note: Modern landscape: paved farm road between ploughed fields, a wind turbine, village on the horizon; no Roman remains visible.

verdicts.file: Grabungsplan des Legionslager Albing nach den Befunden von 1904-1905 .png
verdicts.note: Drawn excavation plan of the Albing legionary camp, a component of the Alb Limes: labelled gates praetoria, decumana, principalis dextra and excavated trenches.
Modern farm scene: tractor and trailer full of collected field stones on a ploughed field, two people; no Roman structures visible.

verdicts.file: 600px Dungi roșu cu alb și un fotbalist în vernil.png
verdicts.note: Flat graphic: green footballer silhouette on red-white vertical stripes, a club emblem; nothing archaeological.

verdicts.file: 600px Dungi negru și alb cu un fotbalist în vernil.png
verdicts.note: Flat graphic: green footballer silhouette on black-white vertical stripes, a club emblem; nothing archaeological.
Map titled 'Der Norisch-Pannonische Limes in Oesterreich' with Austrian Danube forts; Albing is only a label, not the German Alb Limes.
Bare tree with a small dark plaque, bench and fence on a grassy hillside; no recognisable Roman remains, the plaque is unreadable.
